https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mdbgene.title: 2027 - CRM Engineering Intern, Gurugram
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mdbgene.desc:
We’re seeking a CRM Engineering Intern to help build and improve the Salesforce platform that supports MongoDB’s global Sales organization. You’ll work with experienced engineers and product partners to create scalable CRM capabilities that streamline customer interactions and support business growth. 
 What you’ll do 
Design, build, test, and document Salesforce features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools, with guidance from senior engineers. 
Collaborate with product managers and business partners to improve CRM usability and support Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams. 
Help debug, deploy, and maintain scalable solutions; participate in peer reviews and design discussions. 
Take part in Agile ceremonies, including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
Research Salesforce releases, AppExchange solutions, automation, and AI-enabled development tools, and share ideas for improving the platform. 
 What we are looking for in you 
In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
Have a minimum of one quarter/semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes. 
Interested in Salesforce engineering, CRM platforms, or business systems integration. 
Bring a problem-solving mindset and curiosity about how technology supports business processes. 
Communicate clearly, collaborate well, and are eager to learn in a dynamic environment. 
Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM system is a plus. 
Understanding of databases, APIs, or data integration concepts is a plus. 
 What you’ll find at MongoDB 
 Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We believe embracing the power of differences broadens perspectives and fosters innovation. 
 Personalized Mentorship: A mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to support your growth. 
 Career Coaching Sessions: A tailored training program designed for interns’ personal and professional development. 
 Work-Life Harmony: “Bloom for Interns,” with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more. 
 Impactful Projects: Contribute to meaningful work that makes an impact. 
 Exclusive Networking: Join Speaker Series and Roundtables with executives and department leaders. 
 Vibrant Community: Connect with fellow interns through social events, virtual gatherings, and local activities. 
 Path to Full-Time: Explore a longer-term future at MongoDB, with the possibility of receiving a full-time offer at the end of the summer. 
MongoDB internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 10 consecutive weeks, from June through August. Interns follow the “in office” working model and are expected to be in their office location 3–5 days a week. 
Because we receive a high volume of applications, it may take up to six weeks to hear back about your application status. We aim to respond sooner and appreciate your patience as we carefully review each application. 
 About Us 
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We help organizations of all sizes build, scale, and run modern applications by modernizing legacy workloads, supporting innovation, and enabling AI. Our developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is a globally distributed, multi-cloud database available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and more than 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, leading organizations such as Samsung and Toyota trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications. 
MongoDB is committed to providing necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. To request an accommodation, please inform your Early Talent Recruiter. 
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

 The right candidate for this role will 
Be in the process of receiving a Masters degree in Human Resources, or related fields 
Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Google Suite 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and projects 
Excellent communication skills 
Experience or familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) is a plus and would be a valuable addition. 
 You might be an especially great fit if you 
Enjoy wrangling huge amounts of data and exploring new data sets 
Love working with ambiguity and problem solving 
Present fresh and innovative solutions by thinking out of the box 
Looking for ways on how processes can be optimized 
Enjoy working with individuals across multiple countries and regions (& time zones) 
 As a HR Program Management Intern, you will 
Be paired with a mentor, who will support you throughout your internship 
Get to work in meaningful & real-world projects right from the beginning, helping with presentations and documentation 
Collaborate with other HR COEs, HR Leaders, Finance, HRIS, and stakeholders, taking learning opportunities that will arise every single day
